title: Smita Patil's birth chart
metaDescription: Smita Patil's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 23.1° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Libra — the Sun, Mercury, Mars and Neptune. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 23.1° Libra. That falls in the third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Mercury in the classical scheme — an air sign read through a cardinal season.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Mercury holds 15.9° Libra, Venus holds 5.3° Scorpio, Mars holds 2.4° Libra — in the old shorthand, a mind at home in argument and pattern; taste tuned to mood and undertow; drive that argues its way forward.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Mars to Uranus, a sextile with 0.3° of slack. A sextile is an offer rather than a given: available when it is reached for, quiet when it is not. Behind it, Neptune sextile Pluto at 0.3°, and Jupiter sextile Neptune at 1.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Four planets here sit in a sign the classical scheme scores. The Sun in Libra at 23.1° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; the Moon in Scorpio at 9.9° is in fall; Venus in Scorpio at 5.3° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Libra at 2.4° is in detriment. The old table grades terrain, not talent — a placement in fall works uphill, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 4 in air, 3 in water, 3 in fire by element, 6 fixed, 4 cardinal by modality. No settled placement falls in earth — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Mercury was retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Scorpio for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.3° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 9.9°.
